Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
James Coupe wrote:
> On the same subject, Camarilla Exemplary isn't actually put on the
> vampire, right?
>
> So what happens if, as a bargain, say, I vote in one of my prey's
> vampire's as Camarilla Exemplary (knowing full well I'll never block
> him). What happens, then, if I get ousted? Cam. Exe. says "for the
> rest of the game" - does that count once I'm ousted?

Yes.

When you are ousted, _cards_ (and counters) you control and
_cards_ (and counters (?)) you own are burned. Miscellaneous
effects, like CamEx, are not affected.
